jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

Location: Täby

jobs.occupation: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
jobs.description:
We are looking for a licensed veterinarian with a few years of professional experience who wants to become part of our team and work broadly within small animal practice. With us, you will have the opportunity to use and further develop your expertise across several areas, from outpatient care and inpatient wards to emergency medicine, surgery, and on-call work.
About AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.
My name is Jens Berisson, and I work as the Hospital Director here at AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital. We are now looking to strengthen our fantastic team and are seeking a licensed veterinarian who is passionate about animal healthcare and wants to continue developing the hospital together with us.
About the Role
This role is ideal for someone who appreciates that no two days are the same. Your primary focus will be tailored to your experience and interests, but we would like you to be comfortable working across different areas of the hospital.
Examples of responsibilities include:

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.

Emergency patients and emergency medicine.

Surgery and perioperative care.

On-call and evening shifts.

More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.

Who Are You?
We believe you are a veterinarian who:

Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.

Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.

Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.

Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.

Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.

Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.

Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.

Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.
Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?
At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.
We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.
What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.
About AniCura Sweden
Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.
With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.
Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.
We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension schemes, insurance coverage, and wellness benefits, as well as excellent opportunities for continued professional development throughout your career.
Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.
Would You Like to Join Our Team?
If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!
If you have questions about the position or your development opportunities with us, please contact:
Jens Berisson, Hospital Director jens.berisson@anicura.se
Emma Idman, Talent Acquisition Partner emma.idman@anicura.se
Welcome to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital – where you can make full use of your veterinary expertise.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Organising feeding, watering, bedding, grooming and general horse care.
Monitoring the health, fitness, condition and welfare of each horse.

Managing the day-to-day operation of the stable and equestrian facilities.

Riding and exercising horses in accordance with their individual training requirements and ability.
Assisting with the preparation of horses for showjumping competitions.
Coordinating competition schedules and transport arrangements.
Ensuring horses are appropriately prepared and cared for before and after competitions.
Understanding the particular needs of competition horses and maintaining their fitness and wellbeing.

5. Administration and business operations
Maintaining daily records relating to horse care, health and stable activities.
Coordinating veterinary and farrier bookings.
Managing stock levels and ordering feed, bedding and supplies.
Assisting with scheduling, planning and general business administration.
Reporting operational issues and contributing to the efficient running of the business.

Applicants must demonstrate:
Significant professional experience working with horses.
Previous experience managing or supervising an equestrian yard or stable.
Strong knowledge of horse health, welfare, feeding and stable management.

Practical riding experience and the ability to exercise horses appropriately.
Experience organising staff and managing daily operational responsibilities.
Good organisational, administrative and communication skills.
The ability to work independently and take responsibility for decisions.
A reliable, flexible and hardworking attitude.

Formal equestrian qualifications are desirable, although substantial relevant professional experience will also be considered.

Good spoken and written English is required.

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.

Be an expert of the licensing structure and provisioning at RaySearch

jobs.description:
About the job
As a Data Architect, you will shape the future architecture of Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform. You will work across business domains, source systems, data products and technical teams to create a connected, scalable and governed data landscape. Combining strategic architecture with hands-on data modelling, you will assess the current landscape, define the target architecture and help teams bridge the gap between the current and future states. 
 
Alfa Laval's global data landscape spans research and development, sales, service, operations, supply chain, finance, HR and sustainability, with data distributed across multiple source systems and structures. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and solution architects, data product teams, developers and platform engineers to establish common standards, models and architectural principles. Your work will make enterprise data easier to find, understand, integrate and reuse, creating a scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, digital products and AI. 
 
Key responsibilities 
Define and drive a coherent data architecture for Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform-creating one connected architectural direction across business domains, systems, products and value streams, including ERP, CRM and domain-specific solutions. 
Establish and promote common architectural principles, standards and guardrails for data modelling, governance, integration, interoperability, security, quality, scalability and reuse across the platform. 
Shape the target architecture and roadmap by assessing the current landscape, identifying gaps and dependencies, and defining practical steps towards a unified future state. 
Create and maintain consistent, reusable data models across business domains, supporting common definitions and enabling data to be used across multiple analytics and business use cases. 
Translate business requirements into enterprise-level data architecture, ensuring that data products and platform capabilities align with the overall architecture rather than creating isolated solutions. 
Work hands-on with architects, data engineers and developers to implement data models, integration patterns and shared platform capabilities. 
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align priorities, explain architectural decisions, resolve trade-offs and build support across organizational boundaries. 
Collaborate with other architects and evaluate technologies to ensure the platform can support future analytics, AI and digital business needs. 

 
Who are you
You are a strategic and hands-on data architect who is comfortable working with ambiguity, navigating complex organizations and making decisions with incomplete information. You are pragmatic and structured, with a focus on implementable outcomes and long-term business value. Rather than creating isolated solutions, you are motivated by building reusable capabilities that can support the organization over time. You are curious and forward-looking, while remaining grounded in practical delivery. 
 
You build strong working relationships with business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with people at different levels and in different disciplines. You explain complex architectural topics clearly and practically, facilitate discussions, create alignment across organizational silos, and use communication and influencing skills to drive change. You are collaborative and approachable, while also being prepared to constructively challenge existing assumptions and approaches when this helps create better outcomes across a global, matrixed organization. 
 
What you know
To succeed in this role, you bring strong experience in data architecture and modelling, combined with the technical expertise needed to shape and implement scalable cloud-based data platforms. We believe you have: 
At least five years of experience in data architecture, enterprise data architecture, data platform architecture or a related senior data role. 
Proven experience designing and implementing modern cloud-based data and analytics architectures in enterprise environments, preferably using Microsoft Azure and Azure data services. 
Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including translating business requirements into data architecture and implementable data models. 
Ability to balance platform standardization with domain autonomy, enabling reusable data products while supporting business-specific needs. 
Experience designing data integration, transformation and orchestration solutions, including enterprise integration patterns and cross-system data flows. 
Experience defining target architecture, architectural principles, standards and implementation roadmaps. 
Experience working with enterprise data platforms, data products, including data mesh or similar distributed data concepts. 
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, or similar tools. 
Experience with data governance, access models, data quality, metadata management and data security. 
Experience working across multiple business domains, products or value streams. 
Experience working with both technical delivery teams and senior business stakeholders. 
Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

 
It is considered an advantage if you have: 
Experience working across business domains such as ERP, CRM, supply chain, finance or manufacturing. 
Experience supporting analytics, machine learning or AI use cases. 
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure. 
Experience in a large, global and matrixed organization.

About the Tenure Facility
The Tenure Facility is the first and only international financial mechanism exclusively focused on securing land and forest rights for Indigenous Peoples and local communities worldwide. Recognizing and upholding these rights represents one of the most impactful opportunities for fostering sustainable rural development, achieving global climate goals, and mitigating local conflicts in a cost-effective manner.
Through grants and technical assistance, the Tenure Facility empowers Indigenous Peoples and local communities by strengthening their capacity to implement land and forest tenure reforms. Additionally, it supports governments in testing and scaling innovative approaches to land rights recognition, ensuring practical solutions to administrative and legal challenges.
Overview of the Position
The Grants Officer reports to the Chief Operating Officer and forms part of the Operations Team. The Grants Officer plays a key role in the implementation of the Tenure Facility’s grant-making and grant supervision processes. He or she will be responsible for administering the grant processes of the Tenure Facility’s projects and for ensuring that Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and project partners operate within existing policies, guidelines, and procedures.

Generate mutual trust and respect with Indigenous Peoples and local communities and their cultures, with full awareness of the intricacies of relationships among them and their allies and supporters.
Contribute to a collaborative and resilient internal working culture that supports sustained progress toward the Tenure Facility’s strategic goals and objectives.

Shepherd grants and contracts through the review and approval process.

Work to enhance and improve grants management processes and increase efficiency.
Undertake special projects as assigned.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multicultural, geographically distributed team, with cultural sensitivity and respect for Indigenous Peoples and local communities.

Salary by agreement.

Experience from 5G RAN, Baseband or similar telecom systems

Previous experience from Ericsson, Combitech or another RAN/Baseband-related environment
 Experience with scheduling, link adaptation, RRM, MIMO, beamforming or antenna control

 Swedish language skills

Company description:
At Epiroc, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our vision is clear: we aim to accelerate the transformation of mining towards a greener and more sustainable industry. In this role, you’ll get the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art mobile machines, electric drivetrains, and control systems that are moving towards higher degrees of automation and sophistication. 
Job description:Are you ready to shape the future of mining equipment systems in a rapidly evolving industry? Join our dynamic team as a System Engineer and play a crucial role in optimizing the performance, reliability, and efficiency of the complete machine system integrated into our products. 
Join our team 
Our aspiration is to produce the world’s greenest machines using the world’s greenest materials. We are leading the charge towards a more sustainable future through battery-electric, zero-emission mining equipment. Are you ready to be part of this journey? Join our fantastic team of engineers and play a pivotal role in advancing mining technology while pushing boundaries on performance, reliability, and efficiency. 
Your mission 
Your mission as a system engineer is to develop and adapt our machine systems in terms of hardware, system architecture, and functionality to fulfill requirements regarding e.g., performance, availability, and safety. Drive concept development from ideation through requirements decomposition and specification, including trade-off studies, to design, implement, and execute verification and validation of the technical solution, ensuring an efficient and traceable end-to-end development loop. 
You will primarily work in project form with new product development projects, product maintenance, technology development, and customer orders. You will have close contact with other departments in Örebro, for example service, purchasing and marketing, as well as contact with customers and suppliers around the world. Furthermore, you will contribute to the building of modularized solutions, process improvement, and team competence assets. 
Your profile 
You have a university degree in a relevant area. We believe you have professional experience within system engineering or other highly qualified engineering background. You are used to bringing ideas from concept to serial production and are familiar with requirement management tools such as Doors or Polarion or similar. You have proven experience in modularization and systems engineering practices such as MBSE (Model based system engineering), and hands-on experience with Matlab tools and Hopsan. You also have a solid understanding of software, including control systems and system architectures, as well as CAN communication protocols (J1939, CAN Open). Knowledge of software development and electrical systems, and experience with CAD, simulation, and other software tools are considered a plus. 
To enjoy the work you are self-propelled, responsible, and your work is effectively planned to meet deadlines with the right quality. You have a structured and analytical approach, enjoy combining theory and practice, and strive to get the job done to our customers' satisfaction. Furthermore, you have good interpersonal skills, enjoy teamwork, and thrive in a collaborative environment where communication is key. Technical project management experience or R&D leadership experience is a plus. Since your work includes many local and global contacts, it is required that English skills (verbal and written) are fluent and that you understand Swedish. 
Life at Epiroc 
By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be a part of a group of skilled and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. We work in a global environment with 120 different nationalities! 
In addition to the fact that we have a culture that is characterized by development combined with having a good balance between work and leisure, there are some things that makes us a little extra proud to work at Epiroc:   
Global career opportunities, Epiroc University, for your own competence development, Community involvement, benefits package, which amongst other things include flexible working hours and bonus. 
Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility to partly work from home, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual conditions.  
Location and travel 
This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. 
Application and contact 
We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible by creating an account in our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. The last day to apply for this position is November 22nd 2026. 
Hiring manager: Xi Yang, Group Manager R&D,  
For questions about the recruitment process or application please contact recruitment specialist: 
Maria Roseen, +46702590507, maria.x.roseen@external.epiroc.com,

Job Description
About the Role
Are you passionate about sustainable technology and modern software engineering? Join our cross-functional team in developing the next generation of energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions. In this role, you will help design, implement, and optimize intelligent control and regulation algorithms for state-of-the-art heat pumps, directly contributing to the global energy transition.

Your contribution
Shape the future: Develop control and regulation functions for our latest heat pumps, actively driving forward innovative algorithms for energy-efficient, resource-saving heating and cooling systems.
Take a holistic approach: Guide software functions throughout their full lifecycle—from requirements gathering and concept simulation through to implementation and verification across multiple testing levels (MIL, SIL, HIL).
Realize model-based software: Design and optimize model-based software functions in Matlab/Simulink for the closed-loop control of thermodynamic and hydraulic systems.
Implement software: Apply modern software development practices and text-based languages (e.g., C/C++), utilizing modern engineering and AI-assisted tools to advance embedded software modules.
Validate & test: Commission and test application software on cutting-edge heat pump test benches, supporting rapid prototyping and real-world system validation.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work in an international, agile environment, collaborating closely with experts across software, electronics, HMI, hydraulics, and thermodynamics.

Qualifications
What You Bring
Education: Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Mechatronics, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical engineering background).
Core Competencies:
Solid foundational understanding of control engineering, mechatronic systems, or thermodynamic processes.
Practical experience in software development—either through model-based development (Matlab/Simulink) or text-based embedded programming (C/C++).
Working familiarity with software testing or simulation concepts (e.g., MIL, SIL, or HIL).
Languages: Working proficiency / business fluency in English (written and spoken).
Mindset: Solution-oriented mindset, strong curiosity for clean energy technologies, and an eagerness to learn and grow within an international team.

Nice to Have
Several years of dedicated industry experience in embedded software or controls engineering.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, or hydraulic systems.
Experience with bus protocols and communication interfaces (e.g., CAN, LIN, Modbus, MQTT).
Familiarity with agile development practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., Git, Jira, Jenkins).

Additional Information
What We Offer
Impactful Mission: Play an active role in decarbonization and sustainable climate technologies.
Flexible Working: Flexible working hours and hybrid work options for an optimal work-life balance.
Continuous Growth: Access to cutting-edge development tools, AI tooling, and tailored technical/language training opportunities.
Collaborative Culture: An open, appreciative, and international team environment with state-of-the-art laboratory and test bench facilities.

Quintus Technologies is looking for a Forwarder to join our logistics team in Västerås.
Here, you will work with international project logistics, coordinating shipments of advanced high-pressure systems to customers around the world. Our equipment often requires carefully planned transport solutions, detailed documentation and close collaboration between several parties.
You will become part of a collaborative logistics team where you have the opportunity to take responsibility, develop your expertise and contribute to successful deliveries worldwide.
About the role
As a Forwarder at Quintus Technologies, you will be responsible for planning and coordinating international shipments, with a particular focus on project logistics and customs-related matters.
You will work closely with project managers, production, purchasing, external freight partners and customs authorities to find suitable transport solutions, ensure compliance with customs regulations and secure efficient, accurate and timely deliveries.
Customs management will be a key focus area of the role, where you will take an active part in developing customs procedures, handling customs-related documentation and staying up to date with international trade regulations.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Requesting, evaluating and comparing transport quotations and selecting suitable freight forwarders.
Preparing and managing shipping documentation, packing lists and product labels.
Handling Letters of Credit (L/C) and ensuring that the required shipping documentation is accurate and complete.
Managing customs documentation, import shipments and relevant import/export requirements.
Maintaining accurate shipping records and updating information in relevant systems.
Coordinating external warehousing and storage solutions when needed.
Taking greater ownership of customs-related matters, proactively developing customs procedures and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

Who are you?
We believe you are someone who enjoys working with logistics and takes pride in making sure that everything is handled correctly.
You are structured, thorough and service-minded, with a natural ability to keep track of details and deadlines. You enjoy coordinating different activities, communicating with people and finding solutions when unexpected challenges arise.
You are comfortable taking responsibility for your work and understand the importance of accuracy, particularly when dealing with international shipping documentation and customs requirements.
As a colleague, you are approachable, collaborative and proactive. You enjoy being part of a team while also having the confidence to work independently.
We believe you have:
Education in logistics, freight forwarding or international trade, preferably from a vocational college, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of international transportation, shipping documentation and logistics processes.
Good understanding of customs procedures and import/export requirements.
An interest in international trade, transportation and logistics.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

Experience in freight forwarding, project logistics, Letters of Credit (L/C) or ERP systems is highly valuable.
Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the right mindset, a willingness to learn and the ability to take responsibility for complex logistics activities.
Why join Quintus Technologies?
At Quintus, you will work with logistics that go beyond everyday transportation.
Our advanced high-pressure systems are delivered to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical technology. Each project brings its own requirements, challenges and opportunities to find smart solutions.
You will join a forwarding team of four people and work closely with colleagues across the organization. Here, collaboration and knowledge-sharing are important, and you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in an international environment.
Quintus combines advanced technology and a global customer base with a welcoming, down-to-earth and family-oriented culture.
If you enjoy variety, responsibility and international collaboration, this could be a great next step in your career.
Location
The position is based in Västerås, Sweden.
About Quintus Technologies
Quintus Technologies specializes in the design, manufacturing, installation and support of high-pressure systems for sheet metal forming, advanced materials densification for high-quality industrial components as well as high pressure processing for food and beverage to deactivate the bacteria.
Headquartered in Västerås, Sweden, and represented in 45 countries worldwide. Quintus is the world leader in high-pressure technology, having delivered more than 1,900 systems globally to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical implants.
Learn more about us at: www.quintustechnologies.com (http://www.quintustechnologies.com)
